metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed Chrome's default search engine from Google to Microsoft Bing via Chrome Settings in 10 steps.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome Settings, change search engine, and manage bookmarks via bookmark bar or Star button.
metadata.explanation: Chained task: set Bing as default search engine AND bookmark bing.com in the bookmarks bar. Custom getter reads search engine from Preferences and iteratively searches bookmark_bar for bing.com URLs. Metric gives 0.5 per sub-goal. Initial state (Google + no bing.com bookmark) gives 0.0. [Fixed: renamed functions with correct 32-char MD5 hash 7963cff65d97676543d55b7ec9b158c6; replaced nested _find_url_in_node helper with iterative stack-based search to eliminate invalid function name error]
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter get_chrome_search_bookmarks__d8b500d9 -> get_chrome_search_bookmarks__7963cff65d97676543d55b7ec9b158c6 (invalid 8-char hash -> correct 32-char MD5)
Fix 2: Renamed metric check_search_engine_bookmarks__d8b500d9 -> check_search_engine_bookmarks__7963cff65d97676543d55b7ec9b158c6 (invalid 8-char hash -> correct 32-char MD5)
Fix 3: Replaced nested _find_url_in_node helper function with inline iterative BFS stack loop to eliminate '_find_url_in_node should start with get_' validation error

scoring_breakdown.bing_bookmarked: 0.5 - bing_bookmarked field is True (bing.com found in bookmark_bar)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the Chrome Preferences file at the standard path and extracts 'default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name' to determine the active default search engine.
Case-insensitive 'bing' substring check in the search_engine field correctly matches 'Microsoft Bing' or 'Bing', covering the first sub-goal.

Getter correctly reads the Bookmarks file and performs BFS over the bookmark_bar root tree, checking if any node URL contains 'bing.com', which correctly detects 'https://www.bing.com' as required by the instruction.
Metric uses partial credit (0.5 per sub-goal), so both required actions must be completed to achieve full score.
Evaluator has strong negative-control resistance: initial state (Google default + no Bing bookmark) scores 0.0; completing only one sub-goal scores 0.5; completing both scores 1.0.
Platform-aware path handling (arm Linux vs x86 Linux) is correctly implemented in the getter.
All requirements from the instruction ('Set Bing as default search engine' and 'add https://www.bing.com to bookmarks bar') are explicitly checked.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: the bookmark URL check uses 'bing.com' as a substring match, which could theoretically match unintended URLs (e.g., 'notbing.com'); consider using a stricter domain check like 'bing.com' == urllib.parse.urlparse(url).netloc or similar if false positives become a concern.
